answer: I trust a proof kept by other hands, and Glove inspector cotton warrant buttoned onto the glove press is that proof: each cotton is a cutting record witnessed by the master glover. A forged receipt dies at the first cross-check, because the maker kept a copy of their own. Honest work runs 19 minutes a proof; the farm needs 450 proofs, which is 8550 minutes it cannot paint. Curing a proof takes 4 days, and a farm holding 450 proofs cannot cure them side by side. A farm can rehearse the nectar and rehearse the whisper, but it cannot rehearse the beacon, because a year will not rehearse.
